Title: Quantum Error Correction Researcher qLDPC
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

Quantum Error Correction Researcher
Cambridge, UK | Full-time or Part-time | Permanent | Hybrid
Salary: £60,000 to £85,000, DOE

Any offer made will carefully take into account level of experience (including relevant industry experience), transferable relevant skills and previous relevant achievements.

# About us
Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress.
From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges.
But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.
Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology.
QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.
Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality.
We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.
# About the role
As a Quantum Error Correction Researcher at Riverlane, you will help us to develop the world’s first Quantum Error Correction (QEC) stack that will unlock useful quantum computing.
We have a fantastic opportunity to join one of Riverlane’s more science-focused quantum error correction teams, dedicated to understanding fault tolerance on realistic hardware architectures.
This highly collaborative group brings together mathematicians, physicists, computer scientists and software engineers, working side by side across the stack: from new code families and fault-tolerant logic, through understanding decoding and noise-aware analysis, to algorithm compilation and architecture design.
In this role, you will be part of a small sub-team focused on AMO type devices, where you will work on high-impact research projects, combining hands-on technical work with close collaboration across a wider multidisciplinary team, contributing to research and development across the QEC stack.
# What you will do
- Build deep expertise in quantum computing and QEC, particularly focused on AMO qubits
- Explore existing and develop new QEC protocols with the freedom to think independently and creatively
- Work with hardware partners to develop and optimise QEC protocols for their hardware
- Write code to test scientific ideas and contribute to software-focused products
- Share expertise and collaborate with other teams at Riverlane to guide development of various parts of Riverlane’s products
- Write papers and present work at conferences
# What we need
- PhD in mathematics, physics, computer science, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience)
- Strong problem-solving skills
- Knowledge of at least one programming language (Python and/or C++ preferred)
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
- Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to discuss complex ideas with a variety of audiences in a clear and simple way
- Experience in quantum computing
- Experience with qLDPC codes
# Even better if you have…
- Experience in quantum algorithm compilation
- Experience with one or more qubit modalities
# What can you expect from us
- A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, and a contributory pension scheme
- Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Riverlane
- 28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave
- A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities
- A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets

Title: VP Product Design
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

> Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes.
> Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms.
> The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon.
> The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.
# The Opportunity
As AI agents increasingly search, synthesize & act on behalf of users – the traditional search interface becomes optional – or disappears entirely.
That makes the interfaces that remain matter more, not less – the surfaces where humans direct, constrain, trust & supervise intelligent systems.
We're looking for a VP of Product Design to lead the organization that owns Algolia's Application Layer – the product surfaces where developers, merchandisers & business teams build, configure & optimize search & AI experiences – & Satellite, our design component library, the system that powers consistency & velocity across every Algolia product.
This role sits at the center of our two foundational bets – becoming the retrieval & intelligence layer for agentic AI while deepening our hybrid AI search moat – executed in parallel, not sequentially.
# Three design challenges define the mandate
- Automation with control. Our customers demand deterministic control – an AI system that can't explain why Product A outranks Product B creates immediate friction. You'll close the gap between the promise of AI ease-of-use & the lived experience of customers – designing interfaces where business users set goals & constraints that guide AI behavior, with transparency & explainability built in.
- Simplicity as a moat. Algolia's developer advantage is only as strong as its relative simplicity. As platform capability grows – our abstractions must improve faster than our complexity. The application layer is where that battle is won or lost.
- Time-to-first-intelligence. Bottom-up adoption is non-negotiable. You'll own the product-led experience that lets a builder go from signup to a working, intelligent experience in minutes – re-earning developer affinity with each new generation of builders.
We need someone AI-native – a leader who designs with AI (AI-assisted design workflows, design-to-code pipelines), designs for AI (agentic, conversational & generative interfaces) & builds a design organization whose operating model assumes AI as a core collaborator – humans shifting into supervisory & judgment roles as execution is delegated to systems.
# The Job
# What You’ll Own
- Product design vision & strategy for the entire application experience – developer onboarding through enterprise-grade agent orchestration – tied to measurable customer outcomes: adoption, performance & impact in production.
- AI design standards for the company: interaction patterns for agentic UX – trust & transparency, human-in-the-loop controls, streaming & non-deterministic states, explainability of relevance & ranking, graceful failure of probabilistic systems.
- Satellite Design System, run as a product: roadmap, governance, contribution model, adoption metrics, accessibility – & its evolution into an AI-native system with primitives for conversational & agentic interfaces that both humans & AI coding tools can consume.
- A technical product design org – product designers, design engineers, UX researchers, content designers – including hiring, coaching & developing design leadership.
- The quality bar – nothing reaches the market unless it meets or exceeds the usability & performance standards of core search.
- Executive partnership with Product, Engineering & GTM – representing design at the leadership table.
# What You’ll Bring
- 15+ years in product design – 6+ leading design organizations (managers of managers) at B2B SaaS or developer-platform companies.
- Demonstrated AI-native design leadership – you've shipped AI/ML-powered product experiences – conversational, agentic, or generative – & have an articulated point of view on AI design patterns, backed by shipped work.
- Technical depth – comfort with front-end fundamentals (React, component architecture, design tokens), APIs & how LLM-based systems actually behave – latency, hallucination, non-determinism – & how those constraints shape interface decisions. You can review a PR conversation & hold your own in an architecture discussion.
- Proven ownership of a complex technical application experience – serving developer & business audiences.
- Hands-on experience building or scaling a design system with real cross-org adoption – as a product, with customers, a roadmap & governance.
- An AI-augmented personal practice – you use AI tools daily in your own workflow & have modernized how teams work, not just what they ship.
- Executive presence – you translate design impact into business terms with C-level peers.
- A record of growing teams & developing design leaders – not just artifacts shipped.
# Nice to Haves
- Experience in search – discovery, e-commerce, or data-intensive platforms.
- Background as a design engineer – UX engineer, or former developer.
- Published thinking (talks, writing) – AI design patterns or design systems.
# Why This Role, Why Now
Algolia has built category-defining infrastructure; the next chapter is about turning that position into outcome-driven growth – & the application layer is where strategy becomes experience.
You'll own the surfaces where thousands of companies direct intelligent systems that reach billions of end users & the design system that determines how fast the entire company ships.
If you believe the next generation of great design leaders will be technical, AI-native & systems-minded – few roles offer a better place to prove it.
